title: 45-MIN FOUNDATION — WEEK 4 DAY 23
emphasis: FRIDAY HARD • FRONT-LEVER FOUNDATION + HORIZONTAL STRENGTH + HINGE + CARRY
additionalTitle: CONSOLIDATE • RECORD LOADS + FORM + EFFORT • NO ASSUMED GATE PROGRESS
